Venus operates as a lending and borrowing protocol on the BNB Chain. Venus is an overcollateralized money market. Venus issues the VAI stablecoin.

Radiant operates as a cross-chain lending protocol. Radiant is built on LayerZero. Radiant runs on Arbitrum and BNB Chain.

Benqi operates as a lending protocol on the Avalanche network. Benqi offers liquid staking of AVAX through sAVAX.

Notional offers fixed-rate lending and borrowing. Notional operates on Ethereum.
